pages.title: Anshun
pages.description: prefecture-level city in Guizhou, China
pages.extract: Anshun (安顺; Ānshùn) is a city in Guizhou Province, southwestern China. The city is rather small, but the huge waterfalls and caves in the surrounding area make this city a popular stop in most trips to Guizhou.

pages.title: Barra de Navidad
pages.description: town in Cihuatlán Municipality, State of Jalisco, Mexico
pages.extract: Barra de Navidad was once a small farming and fishing community on the east end of the Bahía de Navidad in Jalisco that has become a magnet for upscale seaside residences. It is home to about 7,000 people.

pages.title: Belleville (Ontario)
pages.description: city in Ontario, Canada
pages.extract: Belleville is a city of 55,000 people (2021) on the Bay of Quinte in southeastern Ontario that was settled by United Empire Loyalists immigrating from the United States in 1789. The first local industries were a sawmill and grist mill along the Moira River. Railways and lumber were major employers in the mid-1800s, while the modern economy relies heavily on manufacturing.

pages.title: Firouzabad
pages.description: city in Fars Province, Iran
pages.extract: Firouzabad (Persian: فيروزآباد‎‎ ; Middle Persian: Gōr or Ardashir-Khwarrah, literally "The Glory of Ardashir") is a city with population of 60,000 in Fars province, Iran. The town is surrounded by a mud wall and ditch.

pages.title: Hale'iwa
pages.description: census-designated place in Honolulu County, Hawaii, United States of America
pages.extract: Hale'iwa (Ha-lay-eee-va) is a small beach town on the North Shore of Oahu. It's the most built up of the towns in the region, has some of the better restaurants, and is generally the place to go if you're staying within half an hour or so of here.

pages.title: Vejle
pages.description: town in Denmark
pages.extract: Vejle is a city of 61,000 people (2023) in East Jutland, part of the Kolding–Vejle–Fredericia triangle. Vejle is mostly known for its forested hills, fjord, harbour, shopping, pedestrian mall, and windmill.

pages.title: Anji
pages.description: county
pages.extract:
Anji (安吉县) is a county of Huzhou  in Zhejiang province, located on Lake Tai.
Popular with Chinese tourists from Shanghai & Hangzhou, Anji County (安吉县) offers a glimpse of rural life amid the bamboo forests. The area has 60,000 hectares of bamboo groves.

pages.title: Wroughton
pages.description: village in Wiltshire, England, UK
pages.extract: Wroughton is a large village in the county of Wiltshire. It is part of the Borough of Swindon.

pages.title: Fårö
pages.description: Swedish Baltic Sea island
pages.extract:
Do not confuse with the Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic.
Fårö is an island just north of Gotland. It is one of Sweden's more secluded holiday resorts; being an island off an island, 20 km across, with 500 permanent citizens (2021).

pages.title: Dazhou
pages.description: prefecture-level city in Sichuan, People's Republic of China
pages.extract:
Dazhou (达州; Dázhōu) is a city and prefecture of in southwest China, the eastern Sichuan Basin and the hills parallel valley.
Dazhou has nearly 5,000 years of archaeological history and more than 2,300 years of established history. The site of Luojiaba and Chengba sites is the birthplace of ancient Ba and Ba cultural centers in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River.

pages.extract: Ariyalur is a town in southern Tamil Nadu.

pages.title: New Georgia Islands
pages.description: island group
pages.extract: The New Georgia Islands are an island group in the Western Province of the Solomon Islands. The New Georgia islands are a large group of islands and reefs that are popular among foreign tourists due to their abundant reefs and marine life, peaceful atmosphere and tropical climate.
